integrity_statement: General identities proved by basis commutator, forest incidence, and weighted cycle transfer; independent finite enumeration corroborates small cases. No independent external mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the oriented n-cycle path algebra modulo arrow ideal squared, n at least two, over finite fields; not all quiver algebras, all centralizer structures, or individual commutator fibers. Possible coverage by a broader, unlocated quiver enumeration theorem remains a literature risk.
title: Adjoint-rank distribution and commuting probability of radical-square-zero cyclic Nakayama algebras
